newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land sets 97 capex at 10 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land sets 97 capex at 10 bln pesos.

text.p: Ayala Land Inc was planning capital expenditure of 10 billion pesos in 1997, assistant vice president and comptroller Jaime Ysmael told Reuters on Wednesday after the company's annual stockholders meeting.
Last year too, Ayala Land had announced it would spend 10 billion pesos on capital expenditures but the figure was later cut to 4.9 billion pesos.
"We cut back capex for 1996 after looking at market conditions," Francisco Licuanan, President of Ayala Land, said.
